title: GlyphForge Viewer Shell Static Prototype Plan
prototypeName: GlyphForge Visual Workbench — Static Prototype v0.1
purpose: Plan a lightweight local/offline registry-fed static HTML/JS prototype that lists reviewed visual asset records and routes them into placeholder GlyphForge viewer modes without implementing the full tool suite or approving runtime use.

generatedRegistryPlan.reason: The pantry index remains the planning source of truth, but the viewer should consume a smaller generated registry optimized for tool routing and status display.
generationPolicy: Do not manually invent registry entries when a pantry/manifest record exists.
Carry reviewStatus, pipelineUse, runtimeEligibility, warnings, exclusions, and future-pantry-only flags forward.
Keep registry generated and disposable; source manifests remain authoritative.
Never infer runtime approval from visual names, labels, animation names, scene anchors, or placement JSON.

registryEntryShape.entryId: stable tool-facing id, e.g. gameSlug.assetFamily.assetId or domain.assetId
registryEntryShape.gameSlugOrDomain: gameSlug or domain from pantry/manifest record
registryEntryShape.assetFamily: animation, region-sheet, cleanup-candidate, scene-anchor-background, particle-preset, future-audio
registryEntryShape.derivedPath: derived/cleaned asset path when known or null
registryEntryShape.evidencePaths: array of evidence paths when known
registryEntryShape.runtimeEligibility: manifest runtimeEligibility, must not be upgraded by viewer
registryEntryShape.warnings: array of warnings and caution notes

UIRegions.purpose: Show GlyphForge Visual Workbench title, prototype version, loaded registry path, and global not-runtime-approved banner.
Grouped asset/domain/game navigation from generated registry entries.
Filter by text, game/domain, toolMode, reviewStatus, runtimeEligibility, futurePantryOnly, and warnings/exclusions.
Always visible status strip showing status, reviewStatus, pipelineUse, runtimeEligibility, and no-runtime-approval warning.
Mode-routed placeholder/detail surface for selected registry entry.
Display manifest/source/derived/evidence paths, counts, labels, and pantry notes.
Show denied/deferred regions, warning notes, future-pantry-only flags, historical flags, and behavior/collision/pathfinding boundaries.
Read-only JSON preview or manifest snippet area.
Switch between Dashboard, Flipbook, Region Browser, Scene Composition, Particle FX, and Audio placeholder modes.
Trace selected entry back to source image, derived image, evidence folder, and manifest path.

navigationFlow: Load generated registry JSON from tools/glyphforge/registry/glyphforge-visual-registry.v0.1.json or file input fallback.
Show dashboard summary by toolMode, game/domain, reviewStatus, runtimeEligibility, warnings, and counts.
User filters or selects an asset group/entry.
Shell routes entry to mode panel according to toolMode.
Status/runtime strip remains visible for every entry.
Viewer shows summary/placeholder first; editing/playback/authoring remains out of scope for H5.88D unless explicitly approved later.

firstPrototypeBehavior: preset/effect record display when registry records exist

firstBuildScope: Build a static/offline HTML/CSS/JS shell under tools/glyphforge/viewer-shell-static/.
Load a local generated registry JSON.
List asset entries and grouped asset families.
Open an entry and show manifest/source/derived/evidence paths.
Show status, warnings, exclusions, and runtime boundary messaging.
Show basic summaries for region counts, accepted/denied/deferred counts, animation group counts, and anchor counts.
Include placeholder panels for Dashboard, Flipbook, Region Browser, Scene Composition, Particle FX, and Audio.
Implement the first useful Region / Asset Browser summary mode.
evidencePlan: H5.88D should produce a screenshot of dashboard loaded with registry.
H5.88D should produce a screenshot of a Region Browser entry.
H5.88D should produce a screenshot of a scene-anchor/background entry.
H5.88D should produce a screenshot of an animation entry placeholder.
H5.88D should produce a screenshot of the runtime-boundary/status strip.
H5.88D may export or preserve the generated registry JSON as evidence if produced in that lane.
validationPlan: Validate every registry entry has entryId, displayName, toolMode, manifestPath, reviewStatus, pipelineUse, and runtimeEligibility.
Validate no entry has runtimeEligibility upgraded from source records.
Validate no source PNG, derived PNG, evidence image, game/runtime file, package file, or lock file changes unless explicitly scoped in a later lane.
Run existing asset pipeline provenance/smoke/manifest validation after planning or build lanes.
implementationRisks: Pantry index is broad and may need flattening into a tool-focused generated registry before UI consumption.
Old manifests have inconsistent status/count fields; registry generator must preserve uncertainty instead of normalizing it away.
Prototype HTML files are useful references but should not become canonical code by copy-paste drift.
Scene Composition and Region Browser can look similar but must stay semantically distinct.
Runtime-looking labels, anchors, and placement JSON can accidentally invite runtime approval if status strips are not explicit.
recommendedBuildLane: H5.88D — GlyphForge Static Viewer Shell Prototype
recommendedFirstImplementationLane: H5.88D — GlyphForge Static Viewer Shell Prototype
recommendedFirstImplementedMode: Region / Asset Browser / Sticker Picture Book Mode
rationaleForFirstMode: It immediately helps browse pantry assets, cleanup outputs, accepted/denied/deferred regions, and game asset sheets before runtime wiring. It also reinforces that Scene Composition remains distinct from region/bbox browsing.
openQuestions: Should the generated registry be committed as a static JSON artifact in H5.88D or generated by a script in a later lane?
Should the first registry generator live under tools/glyphforge/registry/ or scripts/asset-pipeline/?
How much raw manifest JSON should the static viewer preview before it becomes noisy?
Should H5.88D include file-input registry loading, hardcoded local fetch, or both?
Should screenshots be generated manually or with a future lightweight evidence helper?
boundaries: No tools are built in this lane.
No prototype HTML files are changed.
No package or lock files are changed.
